**No changes to the app itself.** If 0.2.0 is working for you there is nothing here you need — this release exists to prove the automated build pipeline works end to end.

The installer attached below was built by a GitHub runner rather than on a maintainer's laptop, which is the point of the change.

## What changed

- Releases are now cut by pushing a tag. A GitHub Actions job runs the tests, builds the Windows installer and publishes it, using the token Actions already provides, so no credentials live on any machine and a release can be cut from any of them.
- The job refuses a tag that disagrees with `package.json`, which would otherwise ship an installer whose in-app version differs from the release it sits under — the exact value the update check compares against.
- The README now has a Download section that says up front that the build is unsigned and SmartScreen will warn, instead of letting that be a surprise.

## Install

Download **SysAudio-Scribe Setup 0.2.1.exe** below and run it. It installs per-user; no admin rights needed.

**Windows will warn you.** The build is unsigned, so SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" the first time. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

You will need Windows and an API key from [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) or [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys). See the [README](https://github.com/jodpacharapon/SysAudio-Scribe#readme) for the full setup, and the [Privacy section](https://github.com/jodpacharapon/SysAudio-Scribe#privacy) before recording anything sensitive.
